recentItems.title: Akhil Sachdeva Unplugged | Bread Butter Jam | Piya Ghar Aaya | Awarapan 2
recentItems.description:
In this episode of Bread Butter Jam, Akhil Sachdeva takes us through the story of how music found him. From being a self-proclaimed bathroom singer to a young cricket enthusiast, Akhil shares how, somewhere along the way, music chose him and he chose to follow it. A conversation about finding your calling, trusting the signs, and the sound that was always meant to be his 🎶
